messages:
maya: Follow-up from today's DR postmortem. Capturing owners for remediation items so we can track timelines. Root causes: uneven route withdraw, missing backup manifests in two AZs, and manual runbook steps that delayed restores.

noah: I'll own R-21 (route withdraw tuning + deploy gating). Plan: add a 10s withdraw grace, extend healthcheck retries, and add a deploy gate that simulates 30% region loss. ETA 2026-04-14, ticket OPS-9991.

rachel: I'll take R-22 (backup manifest audit & quick-restore). Nightly manifest checksum + weekday quick-restore smoke to staging. ETA 2026-03-31, job=JENK-2022.

sam: I'll handle R-23 (runbook automation). Script VIP rebind, KMS verification, and a one-command restore helper. Will add a pre-restore checklist too. ETA 2026-04-06, PR=infra/failover-helper-7.

kevin: proposed drills: tabletop 2026-04-07 09:00 UTC (30m) to walk the checklist, full warm-standby drill (eu-west) 2026-04-21 14:00 UTC (2h). calendar-bot: created -> "DR warm-standby (eu-west)" 2026-04-21 14:00 UTC (organizer: kevin)

ops-bot: runbook-lint: DR doc missing "pre-restore checklist" section (docs ticket DOCS-610).

noah: config snippet I'll include in RFC:
```bash
# bgp withdraw grace
bgp withdraw-grace 10
# healthcheck retries
healthcheck retry 4 interval 3s
```

rachel: adding telemetry tag failure_mode=partial-withdraw so we can track recurrence in Datadog. Will add a weekly digest to #incidents with top regions.

sam: pairing welcome for runbook automation tests. @rachel we should coordinate the quick-restore window to avoid rate limits.

rachel: yep, booking 30m pairing slot tomorrow.

maya: action tracker snapshot:
- R-21 route tuning: owner=noah, ETA=2026-04-14, ticket=OPS-9991
- R-22 backup verify: owner=rachel, ETA=2026-03-31, job=JENK-2022
- R-23 runbook automation: owner=sam, ETA=2026-04-06, PR=infra/failover-helper-7

maya: please update this thread with status changes. I'll post a Monday roundup until all items are closed.

noah: ack :thumbsup:

rachel: ack

sam: ack

maya: closing thread for now unless blockers pop up.
